items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: I was playing with George Gaynor and Clayton at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, George Gaynor was about here. He used to go there, that's the first place he ever had.
That's where George Gaynor and Clayton was playing. I was playing with George Gaynor and Clayton at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret.
